paragraphs.text: I’m awaiting the day that someone tells me I have sharp eyes and beautiful earlobes.

This was one of the best James Bond films I've seen. It was action-packed, engaging, and had a brilliant storyline that was wonderfully paced.
It had beautiful, vivid colours, and really brilliant camera work. The special effects were great for 1969 and I'm honestly super impressed.
Overall, I was tempted to go for that 4.5 but I'm gonna stick it at 4/5. Definitely one of my favourite Bond films now!

I did also want to mention the name -- it's almost sad how Robert Pattinson will be the first ever James Bond to not serve under the Queen. For the first time in the history of James Bond, it will be His Majesty's Secret Service.
